items.title: William Russell Interview, 1976-02-16
items.q: he'd had me to talk to Carl Cons who was editor of Downbeat

ctx.x: no he didn't come down here no and he didn't even go to Chicago I was sort of disgusted myself he'd had me to talk to Carl Cons who was editor of Downbeat then tried to get him a few lectures or something so he could get enough money to go to Chicago and he wanted to see Jimmy Noon by that time was his big hero in his first book he'd talk more about the so called Chicago style Teichmacher and others
